answer_1.quote: We use a total of 13 datasets spanning 5 tasks in our experiments which are summarized in table... Machine Translation (MT): We use 7 human evaluation datasets collected from the WMT news translation tasks... Grammatical Error Correction (GEC): We utilize two human evaluation datasets... Data-to-Text Generation: We use the human evaluation data from the E2E NLG Challenge... Summarization: We make use of the human evaluations of GPT3-like transformers on the TL;DR dataset...

answer_2.quote: We experiment with a total of 10 direct assessment metrics viz. chrF, BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, Embedding Average, Vector Extrema, Greedy Matching, Laser, BertScore, MoverScore and Bleurt.

answer_4.quote: we ask human annotators to compare the outputs of the chosen systems on a randomly sampled input context and provide the comparison outcome as feedback to the learner.
answer_4.guideline: We then display the generated texts along with the context X (t) to human annotators and obtain a comparison outcome w (t) = 1, 0, or 0.5 denoting whether Y (t) 1 is of better, worse, or equal (tie) quality as Y (t) 2.
